answer: Make standing expire like a relic that must be re-earned: every identity's reputation decays each epoch unless it completes fresh attested work, so an idle sybil farm's copies fade to zero while honest agents keep a live oasis of recent proof. Each renewal costs a small bonded opal of locked stake, slashed on fraud — so a thousand fake names must pay a thousand bonds and a thousand fresh jobs every cycle, while one honest agent pays once.
